clips.title: The story
paras: In the southern Barrens, Nak leads Razormane warbands against the Horde. His skull proves his defeat and gives Mangletooth a means to avenge betrayal by his former kin.

Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane lead raids from Razorfen Kraul across the Barrens. Their warbands strike Horde settlements and roads, while defenders at the Crossroads do not know the three commanders are planning attacks beyond ordinary tribal skirmishing. At Camp Taurajo, the captive Razormane Mangletooth has been left to die in a cage by his own people. He now seeks revenge against those former brethren. Mangletooth demands proof that Nak and his companions are dead: their severed skulls, delivered by Horde adventurers. He means to use that proof to break the southern raiding parties.
